purpose: Revised 3-card candidate sample for CET4 listening box 0052 after the existing sample was blocked by agent self-review.

source_policy.source_note: Uses legacy content_pool transcripts with unverified provenance as simulated training material. Do not label as true exam content.

front.text: 听完后，选出说话人反复强调的核心观点。
front.task_prompt: 先定位 Let me repeat 后的完整判断，再用 This point is central 复核它是否承接前文铺垫。

options.text: Data sharing across departments is the basis for better decisions.
Each team should make decisions without shared information.
Customer examples are more important than decision quality.
Every improvement depends mainly on reducing department size.

task_schema.focus: Let me repeat / This point is central
task_schema.success_criteria: 能把重复强化的总观点与前后铺垫信息区分开

audio.transcript: Without shared data, teams make isolated decisions. Let me repeat: data sharing across departments is the foundation of better decisions. This point is central to every improvement we discussed.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 A。第一句 Without shared data, teams make isolated decisions 是反面铺垫；Let me repeat 后把核心观点正面说出：跨部门共享数据是 better decisions 的 foundation；This point is central 再次提示这是整段重点。B 与第一句相反，C 无关，D 把重点偷换成部门规模。
tips: Let me repeat 通常提示后面是重点。
This point is central 会把某个观点提升为主旨。
重复重点题要抓重复出现的同义观点，不只抓某个单词。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 Let me repeat 和 central 强化的重复重点

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户在主旨听力中抓住说话人反复强化的核心观点，而不是被铺垫句或例子带偏。

front.text: 听完后，选出被 again 强化的写作提升重点。
front.task_prompt: 先听第一句的写作提升条件，再用 I want to stress this again 后的改写确认被反复强调的做法。

options.text: Students should only write longer essays every week.
Occasional final scores matter more than a feedback loop.
Peer competition is the main reason writing improves.
Regular feedback is essential for sustained writing improvement.

task_schema.focus: I want to stress this again / matters more than
task_schema.success_criteria: 能把重复表达合并成一个稳定主旨，而不是选局部干扰项

audio.transcript: Students improve fastest when feedback comes regularly. I want to stress this again: a steady feedback loop matters more than occasional final scores.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 D。第一句说 feedback comes regularly 时学生进步最快；第二句 I want to stress this again 直接标出重复重点，并把它改写为 a steady feedback loop matters more than occasional final scores。A 新增 longer essays，B 颠倒比较关系，C 无中生有。
tips: again、repeat、stress this 都是重复重点信号。
regular feedback 和 steady feedback loop 是同义强化。
比较句里 matters more than 后前后关系不能倒置。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 用 again/stress 信号识别持续反馈这一重复重点

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 帮助用户把多次改写的同一观点合并为主旨，减少被单一细节词误导。

front.text: 听完后，选出 Once more 后再次强调的客户信任重点。
front.task_prompt: 先抓 but 后的信息重心，再听 Once more 后哪一内容被再次强调并带来结果。

options.text: Cost control is the only driver of customer trust.
Clients return mainly because prices change often.
Service consistency keeps customer trust and brings clients back.
Customer trust does not depend on service experience.

task_schema.action: 四选一：重复强调句匹配
task_schema.success_criteria: 能从让步信息中切换到被重复强调的主旨

audio.transcript: Cost control is important, but service consistency is the real driver of customer trust. Once more, consistency is what keeps clients coming back.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 C。Cost control is important 是让步背景；but 转向真正重点：service consistency drives customer trust。Once more 后再次强调 consistency keeps clients coming back，说明 consistency 才是被重复强化的主旨。A 把 cost control 误当唯一因素，B 无中生有，D 与原文相反。
tips: but 后常出现真正的信息重心。
Once more 后面的内容通常是重复强化点。
被重复的名词和同义动作要合并成完整主旨。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 Once more 重复强调的 service consistency 主旨

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户在让步转折后继续捕捉重复强调点，完整保留主旨对象和作用。
